title: HiC Memory Fact v1
description: One durable second-brain fact (services/memoryLifecycle.ts), ported from deer-flow's deermem schema-v2 fact. The scope/durability/authority triple is load-bearing: the admission gate injects ONLY user-or-engagement + durable + descriptive facts into later runs, and a MISSING label is a rejection rather than a default.

id.description: Content-derived, so the same fact cannot enter twice.

expectedValidDays.description: Per-fact staleness window, clamped at write time to stalenessAgeDays x stalenessMaxLifetimeMultiplier so the model cannot defer its own first review indefinitely.

lastConfirmedAt.description: Advances ONLY when a deterministic regex over the user's own words detected a confirmation. A model nomination alone never sets it.

accessCount.description: Collected only under hybrid or shadow eviction.
